item.title: Daily Habits That Strengthen a Christian Marriage
item.description: Strong marriages are built through daily faithfulness shaped by God's Word. In this episode of Contending for the Word Q&A, Dave Jenkins examines five daily habits that strengthen a Christian marriage through prayer, kindness, service, affection, and intentional care, anchored in Romans 12:10.

item.title: Gossip vs. Discernment: What the Bible Says About Testing Public Teaching
item.description: NAR to Christ episode examining gossip, slander, and biblical discernment, and why testing public teaching is not sinful speech.

item.title: Psalm 4: Resting in God’s Peace
item.description: Psalm 4 is an evening psalm that teaches where true peace, joy, and rest are found—not in changing circumstances, but in the presence of the God who hears prayer. Dave Jenkins walks through Psalm 4 and shows how it points to Christ and the believer’s rest in Him.

item.title: Guarding Your Heart Against Spiritual Drift
item.description: In this episode of Anchored in the Word with Dave Jenkins, listeners learn how to guard their hearts against spiritual drift through Scripture, abiding in Christ, and the ordinary means of grace. Key texts include Hebrews 2:1, Proverbs 4:23, John 15:4–5, Romans 12:2, and Psalm 73:28.

item.title: Love That Endures: Building a Christ-Centered Marriage in Everyday Life
item.description: Love That Endures: Building a Christ-Centered Marriage in Everyday Life by Dave Jenkins In every generation, marriage is tested by cultural pressure, human weakness, and unrealistic expectations about love. Our moment is no different. Marriage is often presented as a path to personal fulfillment or emotional satisfaction. item.title: Psalm 130: Out of the Depths—Forgiveness, Waiting, and Hope
item.description: An exposition of Psalm 130 from the Walking Through the Psalms series, explaining confession, forgiveness, waiting on the Lord, and the hope of redemption in God’s steadfast love.

item.title: Biblical Salvation and the Eastern Orthodox Church
item.description: Pastor Samuel Farag examines biblical salvation and evaluates Eastern Orthodox doctrine in light of Scripture, grace alone, and justification by faith alone.

item.title: Psalm 5: Beginning the Day with Prayer and God-Centered Clarity
item.description: Psalm 5 shows how to begin the day with prayer, dependence on God, and righteous living. Dave Jenkins explains how a God-centered morning forms a God-dependent day and points listeners to Christ as our refuge and righteous King.
